name: AL-04
label: Safe R

model.rationale: Aderholt holds a district with an R+33 lean, won renomination, and out-raised his little-funded challenger by roughly 65-to-1, while markets price his win probability near 98%. overview:
This northwest Alabama seat is one of the most Republican-leaning districts in the country, with a partisan lean of R+33. Robert Aderholt, a longtime incumbent, has been renominated and enters the general election with a large financial edge: about $1.0 million raised and $750,000 on hand, compared with roughly $16,000 raised and under $500 cash for Democrat Amanda Pusczek.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets put Republican win odds near 98 percent. With no competitive signals in fundraising, ratings, or polling, the district's fundamentals point to a comfortable Republican hold.
